written.myAnswer: Yes. Energy can be transferred as work as well as heat.
The absolute enthalpy of a system cannot be measured directly; only changes in enthalpy can be measured.
Enthalpy (H) is the total heat content of a system; enthalpy change (ΔH) is the difference in enthalpy between its final and initial states.
Heat is energy transferred because of a temperature difference. Enthalpy is a property of a system. At constant pressure, the enthalpy change equals the heat absorbed or released.
